title: Austin Special Election Results Certified
summary:
*   A special meeting was convened specifically to address the recent municipal election.
*   The primary agenda item was to officially review and verify the results of the October 7, 1995, Special Municipal Election.
*   Council members voted to officially approve the special election results, making them final.
